title: Colts decline Anthony Richardson Sr’s fifth-year option

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts decline Anthony Richardson Sr’s fifth-year option
sources.description: The Colts have officially declined the fifth-year option on quarterback Anthony Richardson, a move that had felt inevitable for weeks but still marks a significant moment for the franchise. Richardson, the fourth overall pick in the 2023 NFL Draft out of Florida, will now enter the final year of his rookie contract in 2026 and […]
